svg.title: Change harmonic spacing while holding the envelope fixed

cc:Work.dc:title: Change harmonic spacing while holding the envelope fixed
cc:Work.dc:description: Two invented spectra have fundamental frequencies 125 and 200 Hz. Both use the same smooth envelope with peaks at 650 and 1800 Hz; the harmonic spacings differ.

g.text: Harmonic spacing and formant locations are different
A synthetic source–filter illustration; both envelopes peak at 650 and 1800 Hz.
Changing F0 moves the harmonic samples. The chosen filter envelope stays fixed.
These are constructed spectra, not recordings or measured vowel formants.
